Description: The project is for Airlines domain, specializing in SharePoint, Power Apps and .NET technologies for developing and enhancing internal applications. Skilled in building enterprise portals, workflow automation, crew management solutions, and operations support tools, ensuring seamless collaboration and improved business processes across Airline departments.

➢ Designed and developed internal applications for airline operations, including crew scheduling, ticketing support, compliance tracking, and maintenance reporting using ASP.NET, C#, and SharePoint.

critical airline documentation and streamline internal approvals.

internal portals.

operational announcements.

➢ Built SPFx Field Customizers to visually represent operational data (e.g., crew status, flight status)

➢ Implemented SPFx Command Sets for bulk operations like exporting passenger manifests or

triggering workflows.

➢ Collaborated with business analysts and airline operations teams to gather requirements and

deliver tailored solutions.

➢ Migrated legacy airline applications into modern SharePoint and .NET frameworks, improving

system reliability and user adoption.

➢ Provided production support and maintenance for critical internal airline applications, ensuring

minimal downtime.

➢ Designed and developed Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps in Power Apps to digitize airline/ internal processes such as crew management, compliance tracking, and operational reporting.

➢ Implemented SQL Server, and SharePoint as data sources, ensuring scalable and secure storage

solutions.

➢ Created custom connectors to integrate with REST APIs, WCF services, and Azure Logic Apps,

enabling seamless data flow between internal .NET applications and Power Platform.

➢ Automated workflows and business processes using Power Automate (Flow), including approval

flows, notifications, and system-to-system integrations.

➢ Applied role-based security and environment governance policies for managing app access

and compliance in enterprise setups.

➢ Developed reusable components and templates for faster delivery of multiple apps across airline

business units.

➢ Embedded Power BI dashboards into Power Apps for interactive data visualization and real-time

operational insights.

➢ Worked on ALM (Application Lifecycle Management) for Power Platform using Solutions, Azure

DevOps pipelines, and GIT repositories.

➢ Implemented offline capability in Power Apps for crew operations requiring mobility with

intermittent connectivity.

➢ Collaborated with business users to gather requirements, design wireframes, and conduct UAT

sessions, ensuring adoption and usability.

➢ Optimized app performance using delegation-aware queries, proper data source design, and

formula best practices.

➢ Extended Power Apps functionality using Power Fx formulas, JavaScript, PCF (Power Apps

Component Framework) controls, and custom APIs.

➢ Supported governance and monitoring by configuring Power Platform Admin Center, DLP (Data

Loss Prevention) policies, and analytics.

Description: The application is for LNT IDPL. It’s approval workflow where users submits their request in the board proposal along with the attachments and submits to approvers. The approver will review the users request and either forward to LS Head or rejects. The rejected proposals goes back to The approved proposals will move to Legal & Secretarial Head, either the LS Head can close the proposal or further move its legal and secretarial independent body. After their review the proposal can either approves or rejects and sends that status back to LS head. Finally LS Head will close the proposal based on the status of independent body. The dashboard serves to count the incoming task proposals to each department. It composes of two module where first module is dedicated to Board proposal, True copy and other services and second module is a legal workflow.
